description: This file defines a 'Loader' UI component using LightningJS framework. The component renders animated circles as a loading indicator, manages alpha transitions for fade effects, and includes a method to start the animation loop.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A LightningJS component that displays a animated loading indicator with circles fading in and out.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates an interval that toggles the alpha property to create a fade-in and fade-out animation for the loader circles.
